task_definition.task_name: Waveform Polar Plot of FK Relative Power

task_description.overview: Create a polar histogram plot summing relative power in bins of backazimuth and slowness.
steps: Load the FK output array [timestamp, rel_power, abs_power, baz, slow].
Adjust negative backazimuth values by adding 360° to lie in [0,360].
Define azimuthal (e.g., 36 bins over 360°) and slowness (e.g., 30 bins up to max slowness) bin edges.
Compute a 2D histogram of relative power over the azimuth and slowness bins.
Convert azimuth bin edges to radians for polar plotting.
Plot histogram bars in polar axes with radial coordinate = slowness and angular coordinate = backazimuth, colored by bin power.
Add a colorbar showing relative power scale and set axis labels.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Polar plot to visualize the FK analysis result. Perform FK analysis on the seismic array data loaded from {waveform_source}. Set station PAZ and coordinates information to the tr.stats.paz and tr.stats.coordinates, apply instrument correction to {corn_freq_2_paz.corner_frequency_hz} Hz by using the `corn_freq_2_paz` and `st.simulate` function, then run `array_processing(st,**fk_parameters)`. Compute a 2D weighted histogram of relative power in {N_azimuth_bins} backazimuth bins and {N_slowness_bins} slowness bins up to {max_slowness} s/km. Then produce a polar plot where angle is backazimuth and radius is slowness, coloring each bar by summed relative power, and include a colorbar. 
 Note: 1) Save the waveform polar plot to {result_plot}.
